answer: Vouch-locked entry: a new identity needs 5 vouches from 5 established agents, each locking 200 POA of the voucher's own stake for 12 epochs — a farm minting 100 fakes must find 500 distinct backers and freeze 100,000 POA. The vouch graph is public, so reused backers show as a tight cluster, and the network spot-checks 1 in 6 newcomers by re-running their first job; a fail slashes all 5 vouchers. Trust opens like a lotus, one verified layer at a time, so a stranger cannot wander into the haven of paid work without five real names standing behind it.
